`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and uses it to flatten `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself from the MultiIndex returned by `as_index`. Consequently, all variable and constraint builders still receive a MultiIndex even when `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics) is selected, regardless of the transmission-loss setting; the component-data context does not change those arguments.
